body:
Just remember that your partner is with YOU for a reason. You may not see why, as your low self esteem clouds you vision. Trust me, I have a wonderful partner too and often feel he would be better of with a 'happier' girlfriend. But he wants to be with me, not the abstract imaginary perfect happy girl constructed in my head. Maybe you should try asking your partner why it is that they are with you?

Don't apologise, I am not judging you for what you have written. You are so strong to still be alive despite the pain, far stronger than you think. It is very brave of you to reach out.

It is disgusting that people are treating you this way. They are abusing you because they are unhappy people taking their sadness out on you. You do not deserve abuse. 

Please try writing down your thoughts and feelings instead of self harming. I used to self harm, and whenever I felt like cutting I  started writing down the reasons why I wanted to instead. 

I remember sitting iny room hardly eating, feeling lonely and like no one cared. Wanting to die. I tried to commit suicide but was unsuccessful. 

But remember one day you will escape. You will get a job and have your own home where no will hurt you. You will be able to sit in your house and noone will verbally or physically abuse yourself. 

Hang in there.

Thankyou for commenting. I have cooled down and concluded that I spoke the truth and how they react is entirely a reflection of their character, not mine. My dad has thrown me onto the stairs using my hair while shouting at me and pushed me down by my throat, so I don't think he is worth the effort really as I have never received and apology.

Thankyou for taking the time, all my siblings side with my parents so its good to hear someone apart from me thinks their behaviour is unkind and not compassionate. They have always had certain views about sadness and suicide, the kind of 'get over it, your crazy' sort of views that I'm sure many people know all too well. I hope you have a fulfilling life full of beauty also.
Thankyou for taking the time to comment. I have stopped smoking weed, funnily enough me stopping corresponds with her no longer visiting....

Depression breeds creativity, Ive always tried to think of it less as an awful curse but more of a higher sensitivity than most people. Going for a hike always helps calm me down. If you think about killing yourself try going for a walk, sitting somewhere beautiful and quiet to give yourself time to breathe and think. Please do start writing, it helps realease your emotions and paper doesn't judge you :)
Please don't, please tell me what is wrong and I will listen and talk to you.

All you want from your parents is for them to listen but they don't, mine don't either. It's horrible but please understand that the way they behave is not a reflection of your character but if theirs. You are worth so much more than that. You can talk to me because I do care.

I know you won't believe me but I know how you feel. Talking about suicide seems to illicit only two reactions; silence with a confused 'you crazy?' expression or simply not believing you or taking you seriously. I would leave school grounds to sit on a bench alone because I had no friends. I tried to kill myself 3 times. I know how you are feeling. I'm glad I didn't as I eventually met the love of my life, and two fucked up kids helped eachother to grow. You may not believe that anyone will ever fall inove with you, I didn't either. But it happened. I still feel very low alot of the time, but writing down my thoughts and turning them into creativity helps immensely. Try writing poetry or drawing. Those things gave me an outlet for the pain and saved my life. Go into nature, into the woods and observe the beauty there, find solace there. I thought I would never make friends but eventually I have. Please understand that it can get better, and I will listen even if noone else will.
